situation (example wording): "Can you return the murder-to-robbery, robbery-to-aggravated assault, and murder-to-assault ratios for St. Louis, MO; Chicago, IL; Los Angeles, CA; Memphis, TN; and New Orleans, LA for the years 2010 to 2025?"
what the app does today: No rule: a ratio of two crimes was declined.
proposed behavior: A ratio of two crimes ("A-to-B ratio", "A per B"), or of two groups of one crime ("ratio of male to female murder victims": male victims divided by female victims; Jeff 2026-11-22 (card through the coordinator): "compute it", from Homicide Reports for a murder detail, P53) is computed per place per period as the count of crime A divided by the count of crime B, two decimals, with both counts beside the ratio. Several ratios are several columns of one table (Place | Year | A | B | A-to-B ...). A period where B is zero or either count is blank has no ratio, and a line says so. Both counts come from one source with the same unit (P14, D18); no period named is every year by year (P181).
exact default or choices offered: Ratio = A / B per place per period, both counts shown.
status: Decided 2026-11-22 (Jeff, through the coordinator); build: Engine; extended 2026-11-22 to two groups of one crime (Jeff: compute it, two decimals, both counts shown, a line when the denominator is 0 or a count is blank)
